stage: model graph -> external Triton call replacement
execution: Buddy graph transform, then typed IR lowering; no board, no inference

adapter.role: ABI only: result-first -> result-last reordering, descriptor rank cast, RMSNorm sum-of-squares scratch
adapter.declares_archive_entries: yes, with the kernel case's own ranks (compile-time check)

correctness_guards: call operands are explicitly retargeted after displacement: a linear call takes the physical [N,K] weight, not its transposed view; an RMSNorm call takes the pre-norm tensor, not the already-normalised one
interior nodes are deleted only when nothing else consumes them
a shape with no built kernel case is reported as uncovered, never replaced

known_gap.reason: no built f32 linear case for M=16 N=151936 K=1024; the decode lm_head (M=1) is covered. Generation only needs the last position, so the deployment fix is a graph-level last-token slice, not a new kernel.

not_yet_done: numeric execution of the replaced graph (host or board)
attention / RoPE / SiLU / embedding / KV-write are still lowered by Buddy, not by the archive
patterns_not_implemented: attention (the graph holds one fused SDPA op; the library has split QK/softmax/PV kernels, so a whole-attention kernel or an IR-level decomposition match is needed)
RoPE (cos/sin are computed inline in the graph and would have to become explicit call arguments)
KV cache write (in-place update of a graph input; needs an out-parameter form rather than a returned value)
numerically_verified: yes: validation/stage-cd/replaced-28l-host.json and validation/nr-lower/1layer-prefill.json (cosine 1.0000000000, token trajectory identical to FP32, with the last-token lm_head rewrite applied)
